comments.author: masterDDF
comments.body_html:
In version 1.0.3, when I tried to play on Fika-Headless’s dedicated server, it will appear unlimited loading whether it is throwing weapons, switching weapon positions, changing magazines and pressing bullets into magazines (item maps flash), when changing magazines, the hand will make the action of unplugging the magazine but not removing the magazine from the magazine. But it can fire normally and use the scope.

Now that I have updated to 1.0.4, the internal pressure bullets on the dedicated server will still be loaded all the time, but using the “hands are not busy” module to interrupt when the loading bar is full will successfully press a bullet, and then the subsequent pressure bullets will be normal, but the magazine will not be normally pressed when there are 9 bullets.

Now the magazine can be replaced normally, but after the replacement, you still need “hands are not busy” to end the loading.

Now move the magazine to another empty space, and the item map will not flash.

And i see the game log has not error or trace about this mods..
